item.description:
Timbre 0.2.0

Timbre is now one sound that can grow into a rack: describe a sound, flip through six ideas for it, and layer up to three more on top.

  • All your sounds play together on one Live track; from the second sound it becomes an Instrument Rack with one chain each.
  • Each sound has six ideas: step through them with the arrows, instantly.
  • Four knobs shape the whole stack: Tone, Attack, Release and Space.
  • Mute, solo, level and remove on every layered sound.
  • A new start screen with example ideas to tap, and Surprise me (never drum kits).
  • Timbre now lives in the menu bar: click its icon or press Control-Option-Command-T to show or hide it.
  • Timbre no longer asks to record audio; the meter follows Live's level.
  • Sounds saved with 0.1 are not carried over, and Timbre asks you to quit Live once to update its Live script.
